LanguageData.LP_Class_Barbarian.label: barbarian
LanguageData.LP_Class_Barbarian.description: The DND barbarian draws strength from rage: Rage, Reckless Attack, Danger Sense (passive), Primal Roar, Brutal Critical (passive), Relentless Rage (passive), and ultimately Primal Champion. Power uses "rage power" (Melee level and Strength). Resource: rage (+0.5 when damaged by enemies, +0.1 when hitting enemies, -1 per hour out of combat, not recovered by sleep). Cannot use spellcasting class abilities while raging. Martial class: Extra Attack, fighting style.
LanguageData.LP_Class_Ranger.label: ranger
LanguageData.LP_Class_Ranger.description: The DND ranger is a hunter of the wilds: Favored Enemy (passive, choose a creature type), Hunter's Mark, Land's Stride (passive), Volley, Beast Companion (passive), Hide in Plain Sight, and ultimately Foe Slayer. Power uses "hunter power" (the higher of Shooting or Melee, the higher of Dexterity or Wisdom). No resource; abilities only have cooldowns. Animals whose master is a ranger get the animal companion XP bonus. Martial class: Extra Attack, fighting style.
LanguageData.LP_Class_Rogue.label: rogue
LanguageData.LP_Class_Rogue.description: The DND rogue wins with tricks: Sneak Attack (passive), Cunning Action, Uncanny Dodge (passive), Shadow Step, Poisoned Blade, Assassinate, and ultimately Stroke of Luck. Power uses "cunning power" (the higher of Melee or Shooting, Dexterity). No resource; abilities only have cooldowns. Martial class: fighting style; gets no Extra Attack tier and uses Sneak Attack instead.
